name: io.github.nouchix/pqc-khepra-mcp
description: Sovereign compliance engine with 36,195 STIG/CCI/NIST/CMMC mappings. Community tier: free, no license key required — includes pqc_stig (World’s First DoD PQC STIG) and 12 core tools. Sovereign/Pharaoh: all 32 tools, air-gap, SCIF. Run ert_scan to get a Godfather Report with dollar-denominated business impact.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: License key for Sovereign/Pharaoh tier. Community tier runs without a key (free). Get a key at https://nouchix.com.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Deployment mode: sovereign (air-gapped, default), ironbank (DoD/IC), edge, hybrid.

environmentVariables.name: KHEPRA_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory for compliance databases and generated reports. Default: /var/lib/khepra.
